metrics.measurement_boundary: request.accepted to first committed token server_ready_ns
metrics.denominator: accepted requests with at least one committed output token
metrics.censor_rule: accepted requests with zero output increment ttft_censored_before_first_token

metrics.denominator: all formed adjacent output-token intervals of accepted requests
metrics.censor_rule: accepted requests with fewer than two outputs increment itl_censored_insufficient_output

metrics.denominator: accepted requests with at least two committed output tokens
metrics.censor_rule: accepted requests with fewer than two outputs increment tpot_censored_insufficient_output

metrics.denominator: all accepted requests with exactly one terminal outcome
metrics.censor_rule: missing terminal is invalid; results are stratified by terminal outcome

metrics.measurement_boundary: client send start to terminal chunk or structured close observed by client
metrics.denominator: accepted terminal requests with a complete client timestamp pair
metrics.censor_rule: missing client timestamp pairs increment client_e2e_missing; results are outcome stratified
